name: Boarded (E)
body:
Your travels have brought you through a dangerous port, home to both pirates and assassins. Perhaps you’re fleeing a price on your head, perhaps you’ve jumped ship from another vessel, or perhaps you’re merely looking for a new start in a land where the dangers make themselves more obvious.

Benefit: Your familiarity with subtle slayings and toxins grants you a +2 trait bonus on all saves against poison.

In addition, you can pick one type of poison listed below to be immune to, having undergone a long and painful process of building up an immunity to its effects: blue whinnis, giant wasp poison, medium spider venom, small centipede poison, or spider vine poison.
